scientific_integrity: Full algebraic proof with explicitly identified classical inputs; finite checker is corroboration, not independent certification. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for unit-step triples and strictly positive scalar weights; uses the published Lam–Leung vanishing-sum theorem. Does not classify arbitrary spatial triples or give a closed count of five-node optimal supports.
title: Sharp positive Fourier sampling on three consecutive cyclic sites
